description: How one CRL is read, and how several CRLs for one certificate decide: the device's rule (checkRevocation in packages/trust-client/src/x509/revocation.ts) written down case by case. Each case checks 'certificate' (a key of 'certificates', base64 DER), issued by 'issuer', at the instant 'at', against the CRLs held for it in the order given (base64 DER), and nothing fetched. 'expect' is the status, for REVOKED and ON_HOLD the reason, and for every status but UNKNOWN the position of the CRL that decided. CrlCasesTest.java and crl-cases.test.ts hold the service and the library to this file; CrlCasesTest -Dcrl.cases.update=true writes it, with the expectations written there by hand.

cases.name: not-listed
cases.about: A complete, current CRL that does not list the certificate

cases.name: revoked
cases.about: A complete CRL lists the certificate as revoked

cases.name: revoked-without-reason
cases.about: Listed without a reason code: unspecified

cases.name: on-hold
cases.about: Listed with certificateHold

cases.name: unknown-non-critical-crl-extension
cases.about: A CRL extension nobody knows, not critical, is ignored

cases.name: remove-from-crl-in-a-complete-crl
cases.about: removeFromCRL lifts a hold in a delta CRL; in a complete CRL it should not appear, and proves nothing

cases.name: hold-in-older-remove-from-crl-in-newer
cases.about: A hold in the older complete CRL, removeFromCRL in the newer one: the newer decides, and proves nothing

cases.name: hold-in-older-remove-from-crl-in-newer-reversed
cases.about: The same, held in the other order

cases.name: no-next-update-issued-30-days-ago
cases.about: A CRL that states no next update is used for seven days after it was issued

cases.name: no-next-update-issued-6-days-ago
cases.about: Within the seven days it is used

cases.name: delta-crl-alone-revokes
cases.about: A delta CRL alone that lists the certificate: a revocation it shows stands

cases.name: delta-crl-alone-holds
cases.about: A delta CRL alone that lists the certificate on hold

cases.name: delta-crl-alone-silent
cases.about: A delta CRL is not a complete list: that it does not list the certificate proves nothing

cases.name: complete-good-newer-delta-revokes
cases.about: The complete CRL does not list it, a newer delta CRL revokes it

cases.name: complete-good-newer-delta-revokes-reversed
cases.about: The same, held in the other order

cases.name: listed-twice-revoked-then-removed
cases.about: The serial listed twice, keyCompromise then removeFromCRL: the gravest entry stands

cases.name: listed-twice-removed-then-revoked
cases.about: The same entries in the other order

cases.name: listed-twice-hold-then-removed
cases.about: A hold and a removeFromCRL for the serial: the hold is the graver

cases.name: another-serial-listed-twice
cases.about: A CRL that lists another serial twice is not a sound list: it proves no certificate good that it does not list

cases.name: another-serial-listed-twice-then-a-sound-crl
cases.about: A sound CRL next to it decides

cases.name: certificate-issuer-on-another-entry
cases.about: A non-critical certificateIssuer on another entry: an indirect CRL, which is not evaluated

cases.name: critical-certificate-issuer-on-another-entry
cases.about: The same with the extension critical

cases.name: complete-holds-newer-delta-removes
cases.about: The complete CRL holds it, a newer delta CRL has removeFromCRL: deltas are not combined with their base

cases.name: complete-holds-newer-delta-removes-reversed
cases.about: The same, held in the other order

cases.name: unknown-critical-crl-extension
cases.about: A critical CRL extension nobody knows: the CRL is not used

cases.name: unknown-critical-entry-extension-on-another-entry
cases.about: A critical entry extension nobody knows, on another entry: the CRL is not used

cases.name: unknown-non-critical-entry-extension
cases.about: Not critical, it is ignored

cases.name: critical-reason-code-on-another-entry
cases.about: A reason code marked critical is still a known extension

cases.name: idp-names-the-certificates-point
cases.about: The CRL is for the distribution point the certificate names

cases.name: idp-names-the-certificates-point-revoked
cases.about: Such a CRL that lists it

cases.name: idp-names-another-point
cases.about: A CRL for another distribution point does not cover the certificate

cases.name: idp-names-another-point-revoked
cases.about: Nor does what it lists count

cases.name: idp-certificate-names-no-point
cases.about: A certificate that names no distribution point is in no partition

cases.name: idp-certificate-point-limited-to-reasons
cases.about: A certificate's point limited to some reasons does not place it in the partition

cases.name: idp-certificate-point-of-another-crl-issuer
cases.about: Nor does a point that names another CRL issuer

cases.name: complete-crl-certificate-point-limited-to-reasons
cases.about: A complete CRL covers that certificate all the same

cases.name: idp-directory-name
cases.about: A distribution point named by a directoryName is a partition that is not matched here: it covers nothing

cases.name: idp-directory-name-certificate-names-no-point
cases.about: Also for a certificate that names no point

cases.name: idp-name-relative-to-issuer
cases.about: A distribution point named relative to the CRL issuer covers nothing either

cases.name: idp-uri-and-directory-name
cases.about: A point named by the certificate's URI and a directoryName: the URI matches

cases.name: idp-only-user-certificates
cases.about: A CRL of end-entity certificates covers an end-entity certificate

cases.name: idp-only-ca-certificates
cases.about: A CRL of CA certificates does not

cases.name: idp-only-attribute-certificates
cases.about: A CRL of attribute certificates covers no public-key certificate

cases.name: idp-only-user-certificates-ca-subject
cases.about: A CRL of end-entity certificates does not cover a CA

cases.name: idp-only-ca-certificates-ca-subject
cases.about: A CRL of CA certificates covers a CA

cases.name: idp-only-some-reasons
cases.about: A CRL partitioned by reason is not evaluated

cases.name: idp-indirect
cases.about: An indirect CRL is not evaluated

cases.name: signed-by-another-key
cases.about: The CA's name, another key's signature

cases.name: issuer-may-not-sign-crls
cases.about: The issuer's key usage does not allow cRLSign

cases.name: crl-of-another-issuer
cases.about: A CRL another CA issued says nothing about this certificate

cases.name: expired
cases.about: Past its next update

cases.name: issued-beyond-clock-skew
cases.about: Issued six minutes after the instant of the check: beyond five minutes of clock skew

cases.name: issued-within-clock-skew
cases.about: Issued four minutes after the instant of the check: within the skew

cases.name: revoked-in-older
cases.about: Revoked in the older CRL, not listed in the newer: a revocation does not come back

cases.name: revoked-in-older-reversed
cases.about: The same, held in the other order

cases.name: revoked-in-newer
cases.about: Not listed in the older CRL, revoked in the newer

cases.name: revoked-in-newer-reversed
cases.about: The same, held in the other order

cases.name: held-in-older
cases.about: On hold in the older CRL, not listed in the newer: the hold was lifted

cases.name: held-in-older-reversed
cases.about: The same, held in the other order

cases.name: held-in-newer
cases.about: Not listed in the older CRL, on hold in the newer

cases.name: held-in-newer-reversed
cases.about: The same, held in the other order

cases.name: revoked-in-both
cases.about: Revoked in both: the newest revocation is reported

cases.name: tie-higher-crl-number-good
cases.about: Issued at the same instant: the higher CRL number is the newer

cases.name: tie-higher-crl-number-good-reversed
cases.about: The same, held in the other order

cases.name: tie-higher-crl-number-holds
cases.about: The higher CRL number holds it

cases.name: tie-higher-crl-number-holds-reversed
cases.about: The same, held in the other order

cases.name: tie-same-crl-number-first-good
cases.about: Same instant, same CRL number: the first held decides

cases.name: tie-same-crl-number-first-holds
cases.about: The same, held in the other order

cases.name: tie-without-crl-numbers-first
cases.about: Same instant, no CRL numbers: the first held decides

cases.name: this-update-before-crl-number
cases.about: The later thisUpdate is the newer, whatever the CRL numbers say

cases.name: unusable-first-expired-revoking
cases.about: An expired CRL that revokes, held first, decides nothing

cases.name: unusable-first-forged-revoking
cases.about: A CRL signed by another key that revokes, held first, decides nothing

cases.name: unusable-first-silent-delta
cases.about: A delta CRL that does not list it, held first, decides nothing

cases.name: newer-beyond-clock-skew-revoking
cases.about: A revoking CRL issued beyond the clock skew is not used

cases.name: newer-within-clock-skew-revoking
cases.about: Within the clock skew it is

cases.name: newer-within-clock-skew-holds
cases.about: A hold in a CRL issued within the clock skew is the newest

cases.name: old-without-next-update-and-a-current-revocation
cases.about: An old CRL without a next update does not hide the revocation in a current one

cases.name: remove-from-crl-in-newer-good-in-older
cases.about: Not listed in the older CRL, removeFromCRL in the newer complete one: the newer decides, and proves nothing
